title: TherapyEffect
description: A time-ranged modification to how a controller doses, separated from why it was asked for. The effect is what a replay needs and what a follower must see; the motivation is what a reviewer may want and what a person may not wish to disclose. Keeping them in one record but in separate objects is what makes a privacy-preserving projection a field selection rather than a redaction pass - `disclosure: effect-only` publishes 'sensitivity was scaled by 1.2 for 90 minutes' without publishing why.

correlationId.description: Links the effect to the decisions taken under it.

endTimestamp.description: Null while still running. An effect is a span, not an event: 'was an override active when this dose was skipped' is unanswerable from point events.

source.description: Controller or agent that applied it. Structural identity, not the free-text device string.

supersededById.description: Set when a later effect replaces this one, so a human overriding a controller is recorded rather than implied by last-write-wins.

effect.description: The dosing-relevant content. Every member is optional and absent means unchanged; a scale factor of 1.0 is not the same as 'not set', because the first says the controller considered it and the second says nothing.

insulinNeedsScaleFactor.description: Scales overall insulin needs. Loop's override multiplier; Trio's percentage.

basalScaleFactor.description: Scales basal only. AAPS profile-switch percentage, which is NOT the same quantity as insulinNeedsScaleFactor and must not be merged into it.

targetRange.description: Absolute target override in mg/dL, replacing the schedule for the span.

timeShiftSeconds.description: AAPS profile timeshift: the schedule is read as though the clock were offset.

smbAllowed.description: Whether micro-boluses are permitted under this effect. Currently unrecorded by every controller; it is a dosing input a replay needs.

suspendDelivery.description: Delivery suspended for the span. Distinguishes 'chose not to dose' from 'could not dose'.

motivation.description: Why. Optional by construction, and omitted entirely under effect-only disclosure.

classification.description: A closed vocabulary, so a record can be coarsened rather than redacted. `unspecified` is a legitimate published value, not a missing one.

label.description: User's own words. Personal data; never required, and never published above effect+classification disclosure.

disclosure.description: What this record is authorised to reveal, chosen by the person whose data it is. The projection is a field selection, which is why it can be enforced in storage rather than applied by a scrubber that has to be remembered.

provenance.description: How faithfully this was recovered, because most of it is remapped from a controller vocabulary that did not carry all of it.
